plugin.name: Anomaly (default prices)
plugin.description: Default item prices, balanced for vanilla Anomaly economy. Pick this for Anomaly or non-GAMMA modpacks.

plugin.name: GAMMA economy rebalance
plugin.description: Overhauls filter and oxygen tank prices for the GAMMA economy: items cost roughly 2x to 10x more, matching GAMMA's scarcity-driven progression. Installs a DLTX price patch on top of the core mod, no base files replaced. Requires modded exes (included in GAMMA).

plugin.name: FDDA Redone animations patch
plugin.description: Routes tank and filter animations through the FDDA Redone animation manager and adds a dedicated oxygen tank HUD model. Requires the "Food, drug and drinks animations - Redone" addon (included in GAMMA). Leave unchecked if you do not have FDDA Redone.
